author: Partner Threat Feed
attributes.description: Identifies registry run key values that the Verdant Mallet cryptominer creates to start at logon, as reported in campaign PTF-00470. The indicators are synthetic and use reserved address and domain ranges, so they match no real traffic.
false_positives: Security testing that replays known indicators.
A shared hosting address or domain that later served benign content.
attributes.name: Verdant Mallet Cryptominer: Registry run key persistence (PTF-00470)
attributes.note:
## Triage and analysis

### Investigating Verdant Mallet Cryptominer: Registry run key persistence

This rule matches indicators that the Partner Threat Feed attributes to the Verdant Mallet cryptominer in campaign PTF-00470.

### Possible investigation steps

- Review the matching event and the host or user it came from.
- Look for other indicators from the same campaign on the same host.
- Check the process tree around the event for the initial execution or delivery.

### Response and remediation

- Isolate the host if the match is confirmed.
- Block the indicators at the network edge and on endpoints.
- Reset credentials used on the host.
attributes.query: registry where host.os.type == "windows" and event.type == "change" and registry.value : ("MonitorSync", "ServiceCache", "UpdateUpdate") and registry.path : "*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\*"
